newsitem.title: USA: KCS to buy InterCoast Oil and Gas.
newsitem.headline: KCS to buy InterCoast Oil and Gas.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said on Friday it agreed to buy InterCoast Oil and Gas Co, the Oklahoma-based oil and gas exploration and production subsidiary and two gas marketing units of MidAmerican Energy Co, for $210 million in cash, plus warrants.
KCS Energy said would give MidAmerican 435,000 warrants to buy KCS common stock. The warrants had a four-year term and an exercise price of $45 per share, the company said.
The acquisition is expected to close before year-end.

The company also said it entered into a separate agreement to buy related Section 29 credits for a net price of about $4 million, it said. The company was not immediately available for further comment.
